Duplicate Charge and Billing Refund Processing

Document ID: SOP_C20_REFUND_PROCESSING

Category: C20 — Refunds & Adjustments

Department: Billing

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To standardise validation and issuance of refunds for duplicate or erroneous charges.

Procedure

Validate the disputed transaction(s) against the payment gateway ledger.

Approve refund if duplication or billing error is confirmed.

Issue refund to source (5-7 working days) or as account credit (instant to 24 hours), per customer preference where offered.

Record refund reason code for monthly billing-quality reporting.
